messages.content:
Two readers answered the same question about machines at work. Reader A used facts taken from a fact
store; each fact comes with the sentence it was taken from. Reader B read the documents directly and points at
sentences. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- If reader B found nothing, decide only whether A's evidence really states A's answer for the exact subject.
- "same" means the two answers say the same thing. "neither" means neither answer is supported.
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": "A" | "B" | "same" | "neither"}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: If the GUTTER overhead travelling crane at position 10 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified?

Answer A: "P1Y"
IGEA device 10 must be verified every P1Y on 2026-11-14: GRU A PONTE SCORREVOLE is lifting equipment of type fisso (mapping of the rule); capacity 3000 kg is above 200 kg; sector estrattivo: named in the row; built in 1988: more than 10 years before 2026-11-14; Annex VII row for type fisso, sector use, age old (source: DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15). Assumptions of the rule: truck cranes and mobile cranes are treated as mobile, overhead and gantry cranes and hoists as fixed, and the site's sector applies to every device.
Evidence of A:
- [skill verification_interval: device > annex_rows > fixed_or_mobile > capacity > sector > age > row > answer] IGEA device 10: deviceKind = GRU A PONTE | sentence: "GRU A PONTE 10 GUTTER 3000 CA 197 / 88 1988 24984 SCORREVOLE" [igea-equipment, p. 6]
- IGEA device 10: capacityKg = 3000 | sentence: "10 GUTTER 3000 CA 197 / 88 1988 24984" [igea-equipment, p. 6]
- IGEA site: siteSector = Area mineraria | sentence: "Qtà COMUNE Area mineraria Monteponi 19 Iglesias Campo Pisano Masua - Acquaresi 2 Gadoni Miniera Funtana Raminosa 2 Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1 Furtei Miniera Furtei" [igea-equipment, p. 3]
- IGEA device 10: yearBuilt = 1988 | sentence: "10 GUTTER 3000 CA 197 / 88 1988 24984" [igea-equipment, p. 6]
- Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali: verificationInterval = Verifiche annuali (condition: con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni) | sentence: "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali" [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15]

Answer B: reader B found no passage that states the answer. Its note: The facts in force do not answer this question. (the period P2Y is not written in the sentences pointed at)

response.text: {"reasoning": "A's only rule, DLGSALLVII Allegato VII riga 15, sets annual verification (P1Y) solely for fixed lifting equipment used in construction, steel, port or extractive sectors. The question asks for the case outside those sectors, and A's own evidence depends on the site being 'Area mineraria', the condition the question removes. B found no passage stating an interval for that case, so neither answer is supported.", "choice": "neither"}
